kinds.heading: What kind of group exchange is this?
kinds.rule: One hour of time is one time credit. People giving time earn credits; people receiving time pay them.

workshop.title: Workshop or class
workshop.desc: Someone runs a session for a group. The person running it earns the hours they put in. Everyone who attends pays the hours they attended. Any hours left over go to the community's time fund.
workshop.example: Mary runs a 2-hour class for 4 people. Mary earns 2 hours. Each person pays 2 hours. The other 6 hours go to the community time fund.

team.title: A team helping someone
team.desc: Several people give their time to one person. Each helper earns the hours they spent, and the person helped pays for all of it.
team.example: Two volunteers spend 1 hour moving furniture for Tom. Each volunteer earns 1 hour. Tom pays 2 hours.

equal.title: Share equally
equal.desc: Set one total. Everyone giving time earns an equal share of it, and everyone receiving time pays an equal share.
equal.example: 6 hours, 2 people giving and 3 receiving: each person giving time earns 3 hours and each person receiving time pays 2.

weighted.title: Share by amount of effort
weighted.desc: Like sharing equally, but you mark who did more. Someone marked 2 gets twice the share of someone marked 1.
weighted.example: Of 6 hours, Ann (marked 2) earns 4 and Ben (marked 1) earns 2.

custom.title: Type each person's hours
custom.desc: You enter exactly what each person earns or pays. The total earned must equal the total paid.
custom.example: Ann earns 3, Ben earns 1, and Cara pays 4.

inputs.session_length_label: How long was the session (in hours)?
inputs.session_length_hint: We fill this in for everyone. Change it for anyone who came for less time.
inputs.helper_hours_label: How many hours did each helper spend?
inputs.helper_hours_hint: We fill this in for every helper. Change it for anyone who spent more or less time.
inputs.effort_hint: 1 is a normal share. 2 is twice as much.
